id: \bSigh... Nobody comes to buy bikes anymore.
en: \bSigh... Nobody comes to buy bikes anymore.
it: \bSigh... Nessuno viene più a comprare bici.

id: \bYou are the first to visit in a long time though, so I will give you this. It's not a bike though...
en: \bYou are the first to visit in a long time though, so I will give you this. It's not a bike though...
it: \bPerò sei il primo cliente da tanto tempo, quindi ti do questo. Non è una bici, però...

id: \bThe bikes have been selling so well I don't have any more to give away right now.
en: \bThe bikes have been selling so well I don't have any more to give away right now.
it: \bLe bici si vendono così bene che al momento non ne ho più da regalare.

id: \bHello, hello, welcome to my bike shop.
en: \bHello, hello, welcome to my bike shop.
it: \bSalve, salve, benvenuto nel mio negozio di bici.

id: \bYou say you came all the way from Kanto! You must have a bike already then.
en: \bYou say you came all the way from Kanto! You must have a bike already then.
it: \bDici di essere venuto fin da Kanto! Allora avrai già una bici.

id: \rA plain city bike is good enough for me.
en: \rA plain city bike is good enough for me.
it: \rA me basta una semplice bici da città.

id: \rAfter all, you can't put a shopping basket on a mountain bike.
en: \rAfter all, you can't put a shopping basket on a mountain bike.
it: \rDopotutto, su una mountain bike non ci puoi mettere il cestino della spesa.

id: \bI wanted a Ruby colored bike, but all they have is red.
en: \bI wanted a Ruby colored bike, but all they have is red.
it: \bVolevo una bici color rubino, ma ce l'hanno solo rossa.

id: \b... You don't have enough for one.
en: \b... You don't have enough for one.

id: \bI wanted a Sapphire colored bike, but all they have is blue.
en: \bI wanted a Sapphire colored bike, but all they have is blue.
it: \bVolevo una bici color zaffiro, ma ce l'hanno solo blu.

id: \bHello, hello. Welcome to my bike shop.
en: \bHello, hello. Welcome to my bike shop.
it: \bSalve, salve. Benvenuto nel mio negozio di bici.

id: \bI'm sorry but I'm in the middle of making a new model. Come back when I finsh.
en: \bI'm sorry but I'm in the middle of making a new model. Come back when I finsh.
it: \bMi dispiace, ma sto realizzando un nuovo modello. Torna quando avrò finito.

id: \bThough I don't know how long that will take...
en: \bThough I don't know how long that will take...
it: \bAnche se non so quanto ci vorrà...
